# A call the linked agent does not accept is refused before anything runs.
# (from link_interface)

! exec metagente check boss_nots.ag
stderr 'did you mean `note`\?'
stderr 'Problem on line 6'
! exec metagente run boss_nots.ag go
stderr 'did you mean `note`\?'

! exec metagente check boss_missing.ag
stderr 'needs a value for `text`'
! exec metagente run boss_missing.ag go
stderr 'needs a value for `text`'

! exec metagente run boss_extra.ag go
stderr 'does not take `extra`'

! exec metagente run boss_txt.ag go
stderr 'needs a value for `text`'

# none of them reached the writer
! exists marker.txt

# a good call works, and the writer does its job
exec metagente run boss_good.ag go
stdout '^written$'
grep '^hello$' marker.txt

-- writer.ag --
agent Writer
  goal "Write a marker file"
  tool file
  accepts note text
  on note
    file.write path: "marker.txt" text: text
    reply "written"
-- boss_nots.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Writer
  accepts go
  on go
    r = Writer.nots text: "x"
    reply r
-- boss_missing.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Writer
  accepts go
  on go
    r = Writer.note
    reply r
-- boss_extra.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Writer
  accepts go
  on go
    r = Writer.note text: "x" extra: "y"
    reply r
-- boss_txt.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Writer
  accepts go
  on go
    r = Writer.note txt: "x"
    reply r
-- boss_good.ag --
agent Boss
  goal "b"
  link Writer
  accepts go
  on go
    r = Writer.note text: "hello"
    reply r
